mapper.insert: insert into tcc_transaction (xid, status, expire_time, retry_count) values (#{xid}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{retryCount})

insert into tcc_branch (xid, branch_id, status, payload, error_message, next_retry_time, retry_count) values (#{xid}, #{branchId}, #{status}, #{payload}, #{errorMessage}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: select id, xid, branch_id, status, payload, error_message, next_retry_time, retry_count, create_time, update_time from tcc_branch where xid = #{xid} order by id asc
